deploybot: STARTING rollout to prod (change-window: 23:00-02:00 UTC). env=prod, release_tag=v2.8.1, orchestrator=release-orch

deploybot: Commits in this release (3):
- 9f4b2a7 - fix: kv cache race (author: @sam) - https://git.redwood/ri/commit/9f4b2a7
- 2c3d1ee - perf: adjust batching heuristic (author: @asha) - https://git.redwood/ri/commit/2c3d1ee
- d4b7c99 - docs: release notes + changelog (author: @leo) - https://git.redwood/ri/commit/d4b7c99

sam: noticing the kv cache fix landed late, adding a note to monitor cache-miss-rate.

asha: can we pin traffic to canary for 10m then ramp? suggested rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100%

leo: ack. logs look clean on staging earlier. I left a comment on PR: https://git.redwood/ri/pull/412 (contains 9f4b2a7)

ida: @deploybot whats the rollback plan if we see a spike in latency?

deploybot: Rollback policy: automatic rollback to prior tag v2.8.0 if error-rate > 2% for 5m or p95 latency > 1.5x baseline. Manual rollback command:
```
release-orch rollback --env=prod --to-tag=v2.8.0 --reason="auto/manual"
```

maria: adding an extra watch on p95 and kv-cache-miss. I'll own the first 15m.

sam: FYI the 9f4b2a7 change touches cache sharding, may surface under burst traffic. Recommend keeping 10% hold for 15m rather than 10m.

asha: updated rollout to 10% (15m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (gradual). deploybot, proceed with that plan?

deploybot: Proceeding with pinned rollout. First window: setting route weight to 10% for 15m. Checkpoint: checkpoint-id=cp-202-1987654321

deploybot: UPDATE: weight=10% applied. sha=9f4b2a7, 2c3d1ee, d4b7c99. Monitoring hooks active: subsystems=[runtime, batching, kv-cache]

leo: seeing no errors so far. p95 stable. :thumbsup:

maria: slight uptick in kv-cache-miss (from 0.9% -> 1.6%), but still below alert. continuing to watch.

deploybot: METRIC ALERT (monitoring): runtime.p95 crossed 1.5x baseline at 1987654348 for 2m. Current value=1.6x

sam: rolling back to be safe. initiating manual rollback now.

deploybot: ROLLBACK STARTED by @sam -> rolling to v2.8.0. rollback-sha=v2.8.0 (previous), rollback-checkpoint=rb-1987654349

deploybot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE. env=prod, restored_tag=v2.8.0, duration=2m. final_status=success

maria: good catch. we'll reproduce the kv-shard under burst in a staging load test and file a follow-up PR.

asha: updated release notes draft with rollback summary: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/v2.8.1-draft

sam: opened follow-up issue: https://git.redwood/ri/issues/789 - assigns @sam & @asha.

deploybot: SESSION LOG: checkpoint cp-202-1987654321 -> rollback rb-1987654349. commit refs: [9f4b2a7, 2c3d1ee, d4b7c99]. authors: [sam, asha, leo]. Links: PRs=[https://git.redwood/ri/pull/412, https://git.redwood/ri/pull/413]

ida: leaving a note to schedule a re-rollout in next change window after fixes. Thanks all.
